ssh_key_distribution._comment_keys: Local paths on the machine running CVS. Replace every changeme placeholder below. The private key is uploaded via SFTP (never echoed).
ssh_key_distribution._comment_key_name: Filename the key gets on the remote nodes under remote_ssh_dir. Peers reference it via IdentityFile.
ssh_key_distribution._comment_controlling: Optional. Local path to the controlling station's EXISTING public key to also authorize. Leave as empty string to skip.
ssh_key_distribution._comment_remote_ssh_dir: Optional. Remote per-user ssh dir. Default ~/.ssh. '~' expands on the remote node.
ssh_key_distribution._comment_ssh_dir_nfs_shared: Optional. Set true if remote_ssh_dir is the same NFS-mounted directory on every node (e.g. a shared home directory). When true, the cluster keypair and controlling-station key are uploaded via the head node only -- every other node already sees the same file through the shared mount, so per-node upload is skipped.
ssh_key_distribution._comment_host_pattern: Optional override for the ssh_config Host wildcard. If empty, derived from node_dict keys + vpc_ips.
ssh_key_distribution._comment_verify_mode: 'ring' (each node -> next, O(n)) or 'full_mesh' (every ordered pair, O(n^2)).
ssh_key_distribution._comment_config_block: How ~/.ssh/config is managed. 'managed_block' inserts/replaces a marked CVS block, preserving other content (recommended). 'overwrite' replaces the whole file.
